git_state.last_commit_message: Add mobile hamburger menu with full-screen overlay nav

summary.what_we_were_doing: Building and refining a portfolio site for Chris Gilbreath (screenwriter/author/composer) at chrisg.media — this session focused on mobile hamburger nav and live server setup.
key_decisions: Renamed 'The Work' section to 'Compositions' — per client request

Mobile hamburger menu uses a separate #mobileMenu div OUTSIDE the nav element — nav has backdrop-filter which creates a stacking context that traps children's z-index, so the overlay must be a sibling of nav, not a child
Mobile menu z-index: 10000, hamburger z-index: 10001 — body::before film grain is at z-index 9999, everything must exceed that to be visible
Mobile breakpoint changed to 768px (was 600px) — device was just over 600px, hamburger wasn't appearing
Nav links hide at 768px with display:none — added back after removing the old 600px rule
Mobile menu background is solid #0b0906 (no backdrop-filter) — removed blur to avoid any transparency/stacking issues
Mobile menu link color is #e0d3bc (bright warm white) — var(--ink-muted) was too dark on the near-black background
Live server runs with --host=0.0.0.0 on port 5500 for Tailscale access at 100.64.188.88:5500
current_blockers: Hamburger menu still being debugged — user confirmed nav links not appearing in overlay as of last message. Breakpoint fix (768px) was the last attempt, unverified.
Site not yet deployed to Vercel — remote set at git@github.com:teezlabs/chrisgilbreath-screenwriter.git but no Vercel project connected
Real screenplay titles not provided — Screenplays section is a placeholder
next_steps: Verify hamburger menu is working after 768px breakpoint fix
Deploy to Vercel and connect chrisg.media domain
Get real screenplay titles from Chris to populate the Screenplays section
Confirm info@chrisg.media is live and receiving
summary.important_context: Client: Chris Gilbreath — screenwriter, author, composer. Philadelphia, PA. Domain: chrisg.media. Email: info@chrisg.media. Books: Starr County Line, Bad Blood, Sixteen: Bounty Hunter. Composer credits: Manifest West (2022), Pandemic Response (2021), Mrs. Murphy's Confession (2018), Addicted to Porn: Chasing the Cardboard Butterfly (2017). Font stack: Dela Gothic One (hero), Cormorant Garamond (section titles), Bebas Neue (labels/nav), Lora (body). Color palette: bg #0b0906, accent #b07830 (tobacco amber), muted #7a5c30. No framework — pure HTML/CSS/JS. User preference: no Co-Authored-By flag in commits. Live server: live-server --port=5500 --host=0.0.0.0 --no-browser.
